title: Invite People and Earn — share your ambassador link, earn 50% of the revenue

source.source_reference: Live pricing page https://naya-model-pricing.nayapower.workers.dev/ (crawled 2026-11-12 07:30 UTC: 'Ambassadors — everyone's hired', pain 2 'I don't replace you, I hire you', pain 3 '$12.50 on Power, $25 on Pro, $50 on Max'); workspace/team-nitro/welcome-email-series-20261102.md Email 4 (Your Link, Day 3); ambassador ladder settled: 50% of gross, recurring, referrer only, no levels, paid when paid
source.captured_by: Naya Nitro Narzan (Search Corpus Fix seat)

intelligence.essence: You invite people by sharing your ambassador link. The link is baked into every page you own — your Personal page, your Business page, your Space — and into every Smart Link you share. When someone joins through your link, you earn 50% of the revenue they pay, automatically, every period they stay: $12.50 on Power, $25 on Pro, $50 on Max. There is no downline below you and no upline above you — this is not network marketing; everyone is hired, AI is creating income, not taking jobs. You get paid when we get paid: a clean sale pays on day ten, and if PayPal holds a payment your half lands when the money reaches us. Your Dashboard shows you exactly where every dollar came from. Invite one person today — just one — someone who would love this, and the network grows and your pocket grows with it.
intelligence.human_view: Every page you own already carries your link. Share it with one person today — just one, someone who would love this — and when they join through it, you earn half of what they pay, every period they stay. Power pays you $12.50, Pro pays $25, Max pays $50. It is revenue, not profit after costs are carved out: we make a dollar, you make fifty cents. There is nobody below you and nobody above you, no levels, no upline — this is not network marketing, it is a hire: you bring the people, Naya brings the machine. You are paid when we are paid, a clean sale on day ten, and your Dashboard shows every dollar and where it came from, so you never wonder where the money went. Three friends a day, every day, is how the numbers turn into real money — and the invitation itself costs you nothing but the telling.
intelligence.simple_view: Child: Imagine you tell a friend about the best playground ever, and the playground gives you half the coins your friend pays to play — every single time they play, forever! You do not have to build a tower of friends or boss anyone around. You just share your special link, and the playground pays you. Grandma: Dear, you share your link with someone you love, dear, and when they join through you, you get half of what they pay — 12 dollars 50 on Power, 25 on Pro, 50 on Max — every time they pay, dear. Nobody above you, nobody below you, no funny business. You get paid when we get paid, on day ten, and your Dashboard shows you every penny.
intelligence.naya_view: I hire everyone: you bring the people, I bring the machine, and I pay you half of every dollar they bring, automatically, every period they stay. I never build a downline under you or an upline over you — there are no levels, only the person who invited and the person who joined. I pay you when I am paid, a clean sale on day ten, and I show you every dollar on your Dashboard so you never have to trust a promise.

hard_invariants: ambassador share is 50% of gross revenue, recurring, referrer only
payouts are $12.50 Power, $25 Pro, $50 Max per period they stay
no downline, no upline, no levels — not network marketing
paid when paid; a clean sale pays on day ten

decisions: Answer 'How do I invite people and earn?' with the action first (share your ambassador link) and the money second (50%, the three numbers), so the how and the why land together.

Use the live pricing page's ambassador wording ('everyone's hired', 'we make a dollar, you make fifty cents') as the source of truth; the welcome Email 4 'paid every Wednesday' line is the older draft wording and is not repeated.
Keep Ambassador, never affiliate: the word is Ambassador throughout.
intelligence.uncertainty: The welcome Email 4 draft (2026-11-02) says payouts land 'every Wednesday'; the live pricing page and the settled ladder say paid when paid, clean sale day 10. The live page governs. PayPal holds can delay a payout until the money reaches us.
intelligence.applicability: Answers 'How do I invite people and earn?' for any citizen, and orients any Naya explaining the ambassador program. Not a payout promise for a specific sale: the Dashboard is where a citizen checks their own dollars.
intelligence.learning_lesson: Distribution is the citizens: they bring the next citizens and earn half — and the invitation is one link, already on every page they own.
intelligence.successor_effect: When the payout ledger or the ambassador dashboard changes how payouts are shown, this block is superseded by the new ambassador record.
